name: Siranchowk Khaja Ghar
description: Official web application for Siranchowk Khaja Ghar (सिरानचोक खाजा घर), a 100% Halal Nepali eatery in Khairahani-6, Parsa, Chitwan — featuring interactive Google Maps locator, nearby grounding guide, 3D Nepali Khaja showcase, Gemini dining concierge, Firebase Auth/Firestore/RTDB, and order tracking.
